steps: Prick the potato several times with a fork and bake at 200C for 45 minutes, or microwave on high for 8-10 minutes, until the skin is crisp and the centre is soft
Drain the tuna and mix it with the sweetcorn and Greek yogurt in a small bowl, then season with black pepper
Cut a cross into the top of the potato and squeeze the sides to open it up
Spoon the tuna mixture into the potato and scatter over the chopped chives
Serve with the side salad
Prick the potato and bake at 200C for about 45 minutes until the skin is crisp and the centre gives easily when squeezed
Reheat the chili in a saucepan over medium heat, stirring occasionally, until piping hot throughout
Cut a cross in the top of the potato and squeeze the sides to open it up
Spoon the hot chili over the potato and scatter over the grated cheddar so it melts
Top with sliced spring onion and serve
Warm the pre-baked sweet potato through in a 180C oven for 10 minutes, or microwave for 2-3 minutes, then split it open
Warm the black beans in a small pan or the microwave until hot
Spoon the black beans and salsa into the potato
Top with sliced avocado and a scattering of pumpkin seeds
Finish with a squeeze of lime and chopped coriander
Cook the new potatoes in a pan of salted boiling water for 12-15 minutes until tender, then drain and halve while still warm
Meanwhile, place the salmon fillet in a wide pan, cover with barely simmering water, and poach for 8-10 minutes until just cooked through and opaque
Lift out the salmon, drain, and flake into large pieces, discarding the skin
Whisk the olive oil with a squeeze of lemon juice and season with salt and pepper
Toss the warm potatoes with the mixed leaves and dressing, then top with the flaked salmon and chopped dill
Wash the potatoes well, scrubbing the skins to remove any soil
Boil the potatoes in a large pot of water on high heat until soft but not mushy — a fork should slide easily into the centre without breaking the potato apart
Drain in a colander, then cut the warm potatoes into roughly 1cm pieces
Whisk together the olive oil, Dijon mustard and a squeeze of lemon juice in a large serving bowl
Add the warm potatoes to the dressing and turn gently until well coated, then add the olives, pumpkin seeds and chopped dill and parsley and mix through
Adjust seasoning to taste and serve
Drain and rinse the kidney beans, chickpeas and cannellini beans, then tip into a large bowl
Finely dice the red onion and add to the beans with the chopped parsley
Whisk the olive oil and red wine vinegar together and season with salt and pepper
Pour the dressing over the beans and toss well to coat
Cover and chill for at least 15 minutes before serving to let the flavours combine
Drain and rinse the cannellini beans and tip into a bowl
Drain the tuna and flake it into the beans
Thinly slice the red onion and add with the chopped parsley
Dress with the olive oil and a squeeze of lemon juice, then season with black pepper
Toss gently and serve with the slice of crusty bread
Rinse the quinoa, then cook in a pan of water according to the packet instructions until tender; drain and leave to cool
Drain and rinse the chickpeas
Finely chop the parsley, mint, tomato and cucumber
Combine the cooled quinoa, chickpeas and chopped vegetables in a large bowl
Whisk the olive oil with the juice of the lemon, pour over the salad, and toss well to combine

Rinse the quinoa, then bring to the boil in a saucepan with water and a pinch of salt; reduce heat to low and simmer, covered, until the quinoa is tender and all the water has been absorbed, 15-20 minutes
Transfer to a large bowl, fluff with a fork and set aside to cool
Once cool, add the chopped kale, red pepper, red onion and coriander, along with the black beans, lime juice and olive oil, and toss to combine
Taste and add more salt if needed, then chill in the fridge until ready to serve
Just before serving, top with the sliced avocado, toasted pumpkin seeds and feta or cotija

Rinse the quinoa, then bring to the boil in a pan with water; reduce heat to low and simmer, covered, for about 15 minutes until all the water is absorbed. Transfer to a bowl, fluff with a fork, and set aside to cool
Whisk the peanut butter, lime juice, tamari and sesame oil together in a small bowl to make the dressing
Once the quinoa has cooled, add the shredded red cabbage, grated carrot and edamame, and toss to combine
Add the dressing and toss again, tasting and adjusting as needed
Top with the chopped coriander and peanuts, then chill in the fridge until ready to serve
Preheat the oven to 220C
Toss the aubergine, courgette and pepper with a little olive oil and a pinch of salt, spread out on a tray in a single layer, and roast for 20-25 minutes, turning halfway, until caramelised
Put the couscous in a bowl, pour over freshly boiled water to just cover, cover the bowl, and leave for 5 minutes, then fluff with a fork
Whisk together the olive oil, lemon juice and a pinch of salt for the dressing
Toss the couscous with the chopped parsley and dressing, then fold through the roasted vegetables and chickpeas
Serve warm or at room temperature
Season and grill or pan-fry the chicken breasts for 6-7 minutes per side until cooked through and no longer pink inside, then rest for 5 minutes and slice
Cook the quinoa according to the packet instructions, then drain and leave to cool
Dice the cucumber, tomato and bell pepper
Divide the quinoa, mixed greens and chopped vegetables between bowls
Top each bowl with the sliced chicken, drizzle with olive oil, and finish with a squeeze of lemon
Cook the quinoa according to the packet instructions, then drain and set aside to cool slightly
Warm the falafel through in a dry pan or oven for a few minutes until heated and crisp on the outside
Slice the tomato and beetroot, and arrange over the watercress, rocket or spinach
Add the quinoa and falafel on top of the leaves
Drizzle with the tahini dressing and serve the dark chocolate squares alongside
Grill or pan-fry the chicken until cooked through, then rest for a few minutes and slice
Cook the egg in boiling water for 8-9 minutes, then cool under cold water, peel and quarter
Fry the bacon until crisp, then drain on paper towel and chop
Arrange the romaine and mixed greens on a plate
Arrange the sliced chicken, egg, bacon, avocado and blue cheese in rows over the leaves
Drizzle with the olive oil vinaigrette just before serving
